name: First pack
description: Seven shadows and eleven motion recipes: an elevation ladder, inset, focus and tinted shadows; hover, press and focus states; fade-rise, pop, popover, toast and sheet enters; height, reorder and shared-element layout. Values come from MIT and Apache-2.0 libraries; every recipe names its source.

recipes.name: Raised
recipes.summary: A card or button sitting just above the page: a tight shadow with a faint spread.

source.attribution: Tailwind CSS default theme, (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc., MIT
source.notes: Layers are Tailwind --shadow-sm (0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)). At the default dials the light value is identical. Dark alphas are our own (3x, capped at 0.9) because Tailwind publishes no dark values; not visually verified.

preview.description: A white card on a pale page with a thin, close shadow under it.

recipes.name: Floating
recipes.summary: Menus, hovered cards: clearly above the page, shadow offset and soft.

source.attribution: Tailwind CSS default theme, (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc., MIT
source.notes: Layers are Tailwind --shadow-lg (0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)). Default dials reproduce it exactly. Dark alphas are ours, not visually verified.

preview.description: A card lifted well off the page with a wide soft shadow below.

recipes.name: Overlay
recipes.summary: Dialogs and sheets: the highest level, one very wide, deep shadow.

source.attribution: Tailwind CSS default theme, (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc., MIT
source.notes: Layer is Tailwind --shadow-2xl (0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25)). Default dials reproduce it. Dark alpha is ours (0.75 = 3x 0.25), not visually verified.

preview.description: A dialog-sized panel with a deep shadow spreading far below.

recipes.name: Soft
recipes.summary: Two quiet layers with a negative spread, tinted slightly blue-grey; light and dark values both come from the library.

source.notes: Open Props --shadow-2 with --shadow-color 220 3% 15% / 1% base strength (light) and 220 40% 2% / 25% (dark). Strength steps: strength-4 = base+3%, strength-6 = base+5%. Light alphas 0.04, 0.06; dark 0.28, 0.30. Default dials reproduce both.

preview.description: A card with a barely-there blue-grey shadow, softer than Raised.

recipes.name: Sunken
recipes.summary: Inputs, wells, pressed buttons: the surface looks pushed in, with a one-pixel highlight on the lower edge.

source.notes: Open Props --inner-shadow-2 and --inner-shadow-highlight: inset 0 1px 4px 0 hsl(var(--shadow-color) / strength-10), inset 0 -.5px 0 0 #fff, inset 0 .5px 0 0 #0001; dark highlight #fff1 / #0007; strength-10 = 10% light, 34% dark. Default dials reproduce it.

value.light: inset 0 {{ y }}px {{ blur }}px 0 hsl(220 3% 15% / 0.1), inset 0 -0.5px 0 0 #fff, inset 0 0.5px 0 0 #0001
value.dark: inset 0 {{ y }}px {{ blur }}px 0 hsl(220 40% 2% / 0.34), inset 0 -0.5px 0 0 #fff1, inset 0 0.5px 0 0 #0007

preview.description: A text field that looks recessed, with a faint light line under its bottom edge.

recipes.name: Focus glow
recipes.summary: A page-coloured gap, a solid accent ring, then a soft glow. Visible on any background.

source.attribution: Original values by the Plumb authors
source.notes: Authored for this pack; the gap+ring+glow construction is a common pattern and no values were copied. Colours are placeholders the theme replaces with its own accent and page colours. Not visually verified.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-glow
tokens.value: 0 0 0 {{ gap }}px {var:focus-gap}, 0 0 0 {{ outer }}px {var:focus-colour}, 0 0 {{ glow }}px {{ gap }}px color-mix(in oklab, {var:focus-colour} 40%, transparent)

preview.description: A button with a white gap, a blue ring and a soft blue halo around it.

recipes.name: Tinted
recipes.summary: Four doubling layers coloured like the page behind, so the shadow keeps the background hue instead of turning grey.

source.attribution: Original values by the Plumb authors
source.notes: Authored here. Technique only: layering with doubling offsets (credited on the source page to Tobias Ahlin, https://tobiasahlin.com/blog/layered-smooth-box-shadows/) and matching the shadow hue to the background (Josh W. Comeau, page is all rights reserved, so no values from it are used). Tint colours are placeholders; not visually verified.

value.light: {{ x }}px {{ y1 }}px {{ b1 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.1), {{ x }}px {{ y2 }}px {{ b2 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.1), {{ x }}px {{ y3 }}px {{ b3 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.1), {{ x }}px {{ y4 }}px {{ b4 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.1)
value.dark: {{ x }}px {{ y1 }}px {{ b1 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.3), {{ x }}px {{ y2 }}px {{ b2 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.3), {{ x }}px {{ y3 }}px {{ b3 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.3), {{ x }}px {{ y4 }}px {{ b4 }}px hsl({var:tint} / 0.3)

preview.description: A card on a blue-tinted page whose shadow is a deeper blue, not grey.

recipes.name: Lift on hover
recipes.summary: On hover the element rises a little and its shadow deepens; it comes down more slowly than it went up.

source.attribution: Tailwind CSS default theme, (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc., MIT
source.notes: Easing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) and 150ms are Tailwind --default-transition-timing-function / --default-transition-duration. The 2px lift and the 1.6x slower return are ours (unverified as published values).

apply.tailwind: shadow-raised transition-[transform,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-lift motion-safe:hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-floating

apply.note: Shadow change still needs the CSS class or an animated boxShadow value.

recipes.reducedMotion: No movement, no transition; the shadow may still change instantly.

preview.description: A card; hovering raises it 2px and swaps its shadow from Raised to Floating.

recipes.name: Press down
recipes.summary: While pressed the element shrinks slightly, and it springs back on release.

source.notes: Spring stiffness 500 / damping 25 is the under-damped spring in motion-dom 14.9.0 (dist/motion-dom.dev.js line 4780, "underDampedSpring"; which properties use it was not checked). CSS ease cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) is Tailwind --ease-out (MIT, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/main/packages/tailwindcss/theme.css). The 0.97 scale and the 100ms are ours, unverified.

preview.description: A button that dips to 97% size while the pointer is down.

recipes.name: Focus ring
recipes.summary: Keyboard focus fades the Focus glow in quickly; mouse focus shows nothing.

source.attribution: Original values by the Plumb authors
source.notes: Authored here (100ms is ours). Uses :focus-visible so pointer focus stays quiet. Depends on the Focus glow shadow recipe.

apply.tailwind: transition-shadow duration-100 ease-out focus-visible:shadow-focus-glow focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-transparent focus-visible:outline-offset-2

recipes.reducedMotion: Appears with no transition; the ring itself is not motion.

preview.description: A button; tabbing to it fades in a white gap, blue ring and glow.

recipes.name: Fade and rise
recipes.summary: Appears by fading in while rising a few pixels; leaves faster, fading and dropping back.

source.attribution: Material Design 3 motion tokens via Material Web, (c) Google LLC, Apache-2.0
source.notes: Curves: easing-emphasized-decelerate cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1) for entering, easing-emphasized-accelerate cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15) for leaving; durations duration-medium2 300ms and duration-short4 200ms (all read from _md-sys-motion.scss). Which token Material pairs with which transition was not checked; the 8px rise is ours.

apply.note: Wrap conditionally rendered elements in <AnimatePresence>; exit does not run without it.

preview.description: A panel that fades in and rises 8px when opened, and fades out as it drops back.

recipes.name: Pop in
recipes.summary: Small floating things (tooltips, menus) appear by growing from 97% with a tiny slide and a fade; a bounce dial adds overshoot.

source.notes: Tooltip: animation-duration 140ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) (tooltip.css); keyframes rt-slide-from-top = translateY(4px) scale(0.97) to none, plus rt-fade-in (animations.css). Exit duration 100ms and exit ease Tailwind --ease-in cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) are ours, unverified. The bounce dial is ours: it raises the second control point above 1.

apply.note: Spring form (duration + bounce) is the Motion API; at bounce 0 it settles without overshoot, which approximates but does not equal the CSS curve.

recipes.reducedMotion: No animation; element appears and disappears.

preview.description: A tooltip that grows from 97% and fades in over 140ms.

recipes.name: Grow from trigger
recipes.summary: A popover scales up from the point of the thing that opened it, not from its own centre.

source.notes: Radix Popover sets --radix-popover-content-transform-origin (popover.tsx line 511) and Radix Themes applies transform-origin: var(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin) (popover.css line 16). Base UI exposes a similar variable (--transform-origin): NOT verified. Scale 0.95, 150ms and the ease (Radix tooltip curve cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) are ours combined with Radix values; unverified as a Radix popover default.

preview.description: A menu opening under its button, expanding from the button's edge.

recipes.name: Toast slide
recipes.summary: A toast slides up from below its own height while fading in; the stack settles over 400ms.

source.notes: styles.css: [data-sonner-toast] { --y: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; transform: var(--y); transition: transform 400ms, opacity 400ms, ... } and [data-sonner-toast][data-mounted=true] { --y: translateY(0); opacity: 1 }. No timing function is set, so the CSS default "ease" (cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)) applies. Exit mirrors entry here; Sonner exit was not examined.

preview.description: A toast rising into the corner of the page.

recipes.name: Slide-up sheet
recipes.summary: A bottom sheet or drawer glides up from the bottom edge; fast start, long soft landing.

source.notes: constants.ts: TRANSITIONS = { DURATION: 0.5, EASE: [0.32, 0.72, 0, 1] }. Copied as published; the slide distance 100% is the obvious off-screen start and ours.

apply.note: Dragging to dismiss with velocity (Vaul VELOCITY_THRESHOLD 0.4, CLOSE_THRESHOLD 0.25) is gesture logic, not part of this recipe.

preview.description: A sheet rising from the bottom of the screen and settling gently.

recipes.name: Smooth height
recipes.summary: A panel grows or shrinks to fit its content instead of jumping.

source.attribution: Material Design 3 motion tokens via Material Web, (c) Google LLC, Apache-2.0
source.notes: Curve easing-standard cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) and duration-medium2 300ms from _md-sys-motion.scss. The grid-rows 0fr-to-1fr technique and interpolate-size are CSS features (MDN: interpolate-size is not Baseline, https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/interpolate-size). Spring duration/bounce form is the Motion API (https://motion.dev/docs/react-transitions).

apply.tailwind: grid grid-rows-[0fr] data-[open=true]:grid-rows-[1fr] transition-[grid-template-rows] duration-300 ease-height motion-reduce:transition-none

preview.description: An accordion panel opening and closing with its content, no jump.

recipes.name: Reorder
recipes.summary: When items change order, each slides to its new place with a quick springy settle.

source.notes: Spring stiffness 500, damping 25, mass 1 from the under-damped default in motion-dom 14.9.0 (dist/motion-dom.dev.js ~line 4780). Mapped to dials as: speed scales stiffness by speed^2 and damping by speed (keeps the damping ratio); bounce sets damping = 2*sqrt(stiffness)*(1-bounce). At speed 1 and bounce 0.44 this gives stiffness 500, damping 25.0. Using the layout prop with this spring for reorder is our choice (https://motion.dev/docs/react-layout-animations, https://motion.dev/docs/react-reorder); not tested.

apply.note: Put on each item, or use <Reorder.Group>/<Reorder.Item>. Without the library this needs a hand-written FLIP routine (measure, invert, play), which this pack does not provide.

recipes.reducedMotion: Items move instantly (use useReducedMotion or MotionConfig reducedMotion="user").

preview.description: A list where dragging or sorting makes rows slide into their new positions.

recipes.name: Shared element
recipes.summary: One element (a thumbnail, a tab underline) glides to its new place and size instead of vanishing and reappearing.

source.attribution: Material Design 3 motion tokens via Material Web, (c) Google LLC, Apache-2.0
source.notes: Curve easing-emphasized cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) and duration-medium3 350ms from _md-sys-motion.scss. View transitions: document.startViewTransition (MDN https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/View_Transition_API; browser versions NOT verified, recalled as Chrome/Edge 111, Safari 18, Firefox 144). view-transition-class support NOT verified. layoutId is the Motion API (https://motion.dev/docs/react-layout-animations).

apply.note: Give both places the same layoutId; wrap in <LayoutGroup> when several instances exist. For the CSS route the code also sets a unique view-transition-name per element and calls document.startViewTransition().

preview.description: A thumbnail that grows into a detail view in one continuous move.
